newsitem.title: UK: Celltech says drug failure delays profits.
newsitem.headline: Celltech says drug failure delays profits.

text.p: Celltech Group Plc said on Wednesday that the failure of a lead drug for septic shock would postpone the group's return to profitability.
"This will delay profits by two years," finance director Peter Allen told Reuters.
However Allen said he did not see any need to return to the markets for extra cash for the development of the group's remaining pipeline of drugs.
He said Celltech had 41 million stg of cash on its books and was due to receive a further 10.5 million stg instalment on the sale last year of its Biologics unit to Alusuisse-Lonza Holdings
He said Celltech had learned the results of Bayer AG's late-stage trial on septic shock drug BAYX-1351 on Tuesday.
""We were very disappointed and extremely surprised at the result. Bayer clearly believed it was going to be favourable," Allen said.
